outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry dot plots are scatter plots where each dot represents an individual cell/event; no averaging is being summarized, so individual data points are inherently shown.
Flow cytometry dot plots (scatter plots) showing individual events for PC gating; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid points.
Flow cytometry scatter plots showing gating strategy for MBC; each point is an individual cell, not an averaged summary statistic.

Color-coded overlay scatter plots of individual cell events from different populations (MBC, GC, naive); this is a scatter plot, not a bar/summary chart, so no additional individual-point overlay is needed.
Flow cytometry scatter plots showing gating of MBC subsets; each dot is an individual event, exempt from the individual-data-points requirement that applies to bar/summary charts.
